title.zh: Reddit Is Killing RSS Feeds and Public API Access to Fight AI Scrapers
title.en: Reddit Is Killing RSS Feeds and Public API Access to Fight AI Scrapers

current_state.zh: Reddit will shut down RSS feeds on November 13, 2026 and close public API access by March 2027, pushing apps to its Developer Platform and citing AI scraping and automated abuse, while it licenses data to Google and OpenAI and sues Anthropic and Perplexity.
current_state.en: Reddit will shut down RSS feeds on November 13, 2026 and close public API access by March 2027, pushing apps to its Developer Platform and citing AI scraping and automated abuse, while it licenses data to Google and OpenAI and sues Anthropic and Perplexity.
